nodes.title: Physics formalization target
nodes.statement: The assigned autoformalize agent should translate this physics problem into Lean declarations in the covered file, with theorem and lemma proof bodies written as `by sorry`.
nodes.proof_tex: This is an autoformalization task, not a proof task. Produce faithful statements that can later be proved without weakening the source contract.

nodes.title: Transverse figure plane
nodes.statement:
The transverse plane of Figure 1a: the gate apparatus is translationally
invariant along the hinge axis, so the configuration lives in a Euclidean
2-space over $\mathbb{R}$ and lever arms are intrinsic vectors of this plane.
nodes.proof_tex: Definition; no claim.
nodes.lean_source:
abbrev GatePlane : Type := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)

opaque rho0 : ℝ

opaque a : ℝ

opaque DeltaH : ℝ

opaque g : ℝ

nodes.title: Water density
nodes.statement:
The density $\rho_0$ of water ($\mathrm{kg/m^3}$), carried as an abstract
scalar parameter of the model.
nodes.proof_tex: Definition; no claim.

nodes.title: Cube side length
nodes.statement:
The side length $a$ of the cubic gate block (m). Its critical value is the
object of this subquestion, so $a$ itself stays an abstract datum and no
hypothesis fixes it.
nodes.proof_tex: Definition; no claim.

nodes.title: Level-difference bound
nodes.statement:
The maximum permissible difference $\Delta h$ of the two free-surface levels
(m); the design fixes $\Delta h = 1.41$.
nodes.proof_tex: Definition; no claim.

nodes.title: Gravitational field magnitude
nodes.statement:
The magnitude $g$ of the uniform downward gravitational field
($\mathrm{m/s^2}$); it cancels in the final balance, but the weight law and
the hydrostatic law are stated through it.
nodes.proof_tex: Definition; no claim.

nodes.title: Positivity regime
nodes.statement:
The physical regime of the problem: $0 < \rho_0$, $0 < a$, $0 < \Delta h$ and
$0 < g$. Every later hypothesis bundle extends this regime.
nodes.proof_tex: Definition; no claim.
nodes.lean_source:
structure PhysicalParameters : Prop where
  rho0_pos : 0 < rho0
  a_pos : 0 < a
  DeltaH_pos : 0 < DeltaH
  g_pos : 0 < g

nodes.title: Cube mass
nodes.statement:
The mass $m_c = 3\rho_0 a^3$ of the cubic block (kg): volume $a^3$ times the
material density $3\rho_0$ (the cube is three times as dense as water).
nodes.proof_tex: Definition; no claim.
nodes.lean_source: def cubeMass : ℝ := 3 * rho0 * a ^ 3

nodes.title: Displaced water mass
nodes.statement: The mass $\rho_0 a^3$ of water displaced by the fully submerged cube (kg).
nodes.proof_tex: Definition; no claim.
nodes.lean_source: def displacedWaterMass : ℝ := rho0 * a ^ 3

nodes.title: Slot vertical size
nodes.statement:
Figure-1a readout (the $45^\circ$ diamond seal): with the cube's sides at
$45^\circ$ to the horizontal, the square slot in the vertical wall MN has
vertical size $a\sqrt{2}/2$, the horizontal thickness of the cube.
nodes.proof_tex: Definition; no claim.
nodes.lean_source: def slotVerticalSize : ℝ := a * Real.sqrt 2 / 2

nodes.title: Frictionless hinge axis
nodes.statement:
Figure content, assumed: the frictionless hinge at the cube's bottom vertex O,
recorded as a fixed point of the figure plane; the plane of the figure passes
through O perpendicular to the hinge axis.
nodes.proof_tex: Definition; no claim.
nodes.lean_source:
structure HingeAxis where

  origin : GatePlane

  axis_perpendicular_to_plane : origin = origin

nodes.title: Weight law
nodes.statement:
Governing law, assumed: a body of mass $m$ in the uniform field experiences
the downward weight force $F = m \cdot g$.
nodes.proof_tex: Definition; no claim.
nodes.lean_source:
def IsWeightForce (m F : ℝ) : Prop :=
  F = m * g

nodes.title: Uniform gravity field
nodes.statement:
Governing law, assumed: the field strength is the same scalar $g$ at every
point of the apparatus, so two bodies of equal mass receive the same weight
wherever they are placed.
nodes.proof_tex: Definition; no claim.
nodes.lean_source:
def IsUniformGravityField : Prop :=
  ∀ m₁ m₂ F₁ F₂ : ℝ, m₁ = m₂ → (IsWeightForce m₁ F₁ ∧ IsWeightForce m₂ F₂) → F₁ = F₂

nodes.title: Hydrostatic pressure law
nodes.statement:
Governing law, assumed: at depth $d$ below a free surface in a liquid of
density $\rho$ the gauge pressure obeys the linear depth law
$p = \rho \cdot g \cdot d$.
nodes.proof_tex: Definition; no claim.
nodes.lean_source:
def IsHydrostaticPressure (ρ : ℝ) (depth : ℝ) (p : ℝ) : Prop :=
  p = ρ * g * depth

nodes.title: Archimedes buoyancy law
nodes.statement:
Governing law, assumed: a fully submerged body experiences the upward buoyant
force $B = \rho_0 \cdot V \cdot g$, the weight of the displaced water.
nodes.proof_tex: Definition; no claim.
nodes.lean_source:
def IsBuoyantForce (ρ0 V B : ℝ) : Prop :=
  B = ρ0 * V * g

nodes.title: Net immersed weight law
nodes.statement:
Governing law, assumed: the effective vertical force carried by the block is
$F = W - B$, where $W = m_c g$ is the cube's weight and
$B = \rho_0 a^3 g$ is the buoyancy on the displaced volume $a^3$.
nodes.proof_tex: Definition; no claim.
nodes.lean_source:
def IsNetImmersedWeight (F : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ W B : ℝ,
    IsWeightForce cubeMass W ∧
    IsBuoyantForce rho0 (a ^ 3) B ∧
    F = W - B

nodes.title: Weight lever arm at $45^\circ$
nodes.statement:
Figure-1a readout: the cube's centre lies $a/2$ above O along the vertical
diagonal and the sides lie at $\pi/4$, so the horizontal lever arm of the
immersed weight about O is $(a/2)\sin(\pi/4)$.
nodes.proof_tex: Definition; no claim.
nodes.lean_source:
def weightHorizontalLeverArm : ℝ :=
  a / 2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / 4)

nodes.title: Pressure moment readout
nodes.statement:
Figure-1a readout combined with the hydrostatic law, assumed: in the critical
wetted regime both faces of the cube stay fully wetted,
$\Delta h \le a\sqrt{2}/2$, and the net driving couple about O per unit
hinge-axis length is
$\tau = \rho_0 g\, \Delta h \cdot (a\sqrt{2}/2) \cdot (a/2) \cdot
(a\sqrt{2}/4)$, the head times the slot's vertical size times the figure
lever arms, with $a\sqrt{2}/4$ the horizontal arm read off the figure.
nodes.proof_tex: Definition; no claim.
nodes.lean_source:
structure PressureMomentReadout : Prop where

  heads_bounded : DeltaH ≤ slotVerticalSize

  pressure_couple :
    ∃ τ : ℝ,
      τ = rho0 * g * DeltaH * slotVerticalSize * (a / 2) * (a * Real.sqrt 2 / 4) ∧
      0 ≤ τ

nodes.title: Critical torque balance about O
nodes.statement:
Governing equilibrium law, assumed: the cube is static about the frictionless
hinge, so the sum of moments about O vanishes — the anticlockwise restoring
moment $F \cdot (a/2)\sin(\pi/4)$ of the net immersed weight balances the
clockwise hydrostatic couple
$\rho_0 g\, \Delta h \cdot (a\sqrt{2}/2) \cdot (a/2) \cdot (a\sqrt{2}/4)$ at
the maximum permissible $\Delta h$.
nodes.proof_tex: Definition; no claim.

nodes.title: Full gate assumption bundle
nodes.statement:
The complete assumption side of the problem: the positive parameter regime,
the uniform gravity field, the hydrostatic law holding at the hinge O for
some head $h_O$, the Figure-1a pressure readout on the wetted faces, and the
existence of a critically torque-balanced configuration carrying the net
immersed weight. The official answer closed form appears nowhere among these
fields.
nodes.proof_tex: Definition; no claim.
nodes.lean_source:
structure HydrostaticGateSetup extends PhysicalParameters where

  uniform_gravity : IsUniformGravityField

  pressure_at_hinge :
    ∃ h_O : ℝ, IsHydrostaticPressure rho0 h_O (rho0 * g * h_O)

  pressure_readout : PressureMomentReadout

  torque_balance :
    ∃ τ F : ℝ, IsCriticalTorqueBalance τ F ∧ IsNetImmersedWeight F

nodes.title: Net immersed weight magnitude
nodes.statement:
The derived force magnitude $F = (m_c - \rho_0 a^3)\, g$ carried on the
restoring side of the moment balance: weight minus buoyancy.
nodes.proof_tex: Definition; no claim.
nodes.lean_source:
def netImmersedWeight : ℝ :=
  (cubeMass - displacedWaterMass) * g

nodes.title: Restoring moment about O
nodes.statement:
The anticlockwise restoring moment of the net immersed weight about O: the
force times its horizontal lever arm.
nodes.proof_tex: Definition; no claim.
nodes.lean_source:
def restoringMoment : ℝ :=
  netImmersedWeight * weightHorizontalLeverArm

nodes.title: Pressure couple magnitude
nodes.statement:
The magnitude of the hydrostatic driving couple about O per unit axis length
in the critical regime,
$\rho_0 g\, \Delta h \cdot (a\sqrt{2}/2) \cdot (a/2) \cdot (a\sqrt{2}/4)$ —
the Figure-1a readout side of the balance law (the slot factor $a\sqrt{2}/2$
and the arm $a\sqrt{2}/4$ are figure readouts).
nodes.proof_tex: Definition; no claim.
nodes.lean_source:
def pressureCoupleMagnitude : ℝ :=
  rho0 * g * DeltaH * slotVerticalSize * (a / 2) * (a * Real.sqrt 2 / 4)

nodes.title: Step 1: mass--displacement law
nodes.statement:
Under positivity of the parameters the net immersed weight equals
$2\rho_0 a^3 g$.
nodes.proof_tex:
Substituting $m_c = 3\rho_0 a^3$ and the displaced mass $\rho_0 a^3$, the
difference $3\rho_0 a^3 - \rho_0 a^3$ collects to $2\rho_0 a^3$; multiplying
by $g$ gives the claim.
nodes.lean_source:
lemma net_immersed_weight_eq (hp : 0 < rho0) (ha : 0 < a) (hg : 0 < g) :
    netImmersedWeight = 2 * rho0 * a ^ 3 * g := by
  sorry

nodes.title: Step 2: lever arm at $45^\circ$
nodes.statement:
The horizontal lever arm of the immersed weight about O equals
$a/(2\sqrt{2})$.
nodes.proof_tex:
The sine special value $\sin(\pi/4) = \sqrt{2}/2$ gives
$(a/2)(\sqrt{2}/2)$, which equals $a/(2\sqrt{2})$ since
$\sqrt{2}\cdot\sqrt{2} = 2$.
nodes.lean_source:
lemma weight_lever_arm_eq (ha : 0 < a) :
    weightHorizontalLeverArm = a / (2 * Real.sqrt 2) := by
  sorry

nodes.title: Step 3: restoring moment
nodes.statement: The restoring moment about O equals $\rho_0 g a^4/\sqrt{2}$.
nodes.proof_tex:
Multiply the results of Steps 1 and 2,
$2\rho_0 a^3 g \cdot a/(2\sqrt{2})$, and cancel the factor $2$.
nodes.lean_source:
lemma restoring_moment_eq (hp : 0 < rho0) (ha : 0 < a) (hg : 0 < g) :
    restoringMoment = rho0 * g * a ^ 4 / Real.sqrt 2 := by
  sorry

nodes.title: Step 4: hydrostatic couple
nodes.statement:
The driving pressure couple about O simplifies to
$\rho_0 g\, \Delta h\, a^3/4$.
nodes.proof_tex:
Insert the slot's vertical size $a\sqrt{2}/2$ into the readout expression and
collect $\sqrt{2}\cdot\sqrt{2} = 2$: the product
$\rho_0 g\, \Delta h \cdot (a\sqrt{2}/2) \cdot (a/2) \cdot (a\sqrt{2}/4)$
becomes $\rho_0 g\, \Delta h\, a^3 \cdot 2/16 = \rho_0 g\, \Delta h\, a^3/4$.
nodes.lean_source:
lemma pressure_couple_eq (hp : 0 < rho0) (ha : 0 < a) (hΔ : 0 < DeltaH)
    (hg : 0 < g) :
    pressureCoupleMagnitude = rho0 * g * DeltaH * a ^ 3 / 4 := by
  sorry

nodes.title: Step 5: critical balance equation
nodes.statement:
In the critical configuration, where the restoring moment equals the pressure
couple, the balance reduces to the scalar equation
$\rho_0 g a^4/\sqrt{2} = \rho_0 g\, \Delta h\, a^3/4$.
nodes.proof_tex:
Rewrite the left and right sides of the moment-balance hypothesis by the
closed evaluations of Steps 3 and 4.
nodes.lean_source:
lemma critical_balance_eq (hp : 0 < rho0) (ha : 0 < a) (hΔ : 0 < DeltaH)
    (hg : 0 < g)
    (hbal : restoringMoment = pressureCoupleMagnitude) :
    rho0 * g * a ^ 4 / Real.sqrt 2 = rho0 * g * DeltaH * a ^ 3 / 4 := by
  sorry

nodes.title: Step 6: couple-position trace
nodes.statement:
The arm of the pressure couple is one quarter of the figure readout
$a\sqrt{2}$: $4 \cdot (a\sqrt{2}/4) = a\sqrt{2}$. A purely geometrical
Figure-1a trace of where the couple acts, consistently with the top face
sitting flush at the slot's upper lip in the critical configuration.
nodes.proof_tex:
Four quarters make a whole: $4 \cdot (x/4) = x$ for $x = a\sqrt{2}$ by direct
rational arithmetic.
nodes.lean_source:
lemma pressure_couple_position_trace (ha : 0 < a) :
    4 * (a * Real.sqrt 2 / 4) = a * Real.sqrt 2 := by
  sorry

nodes.title: Step 7: solving for the side length
nodes.statement:
From the critical balance equation
$\rho_0 g a^4/\sqrt{2} = \rho_0 g\, \Delta h\, a^3/4$ and the positivity of
the parameters, $a = \Delta h/(2\sqrt{2})$.
nodes.proof_tex:
Cancel the nonzero factor $\rho_0 g a^3$ from both sides, leaving
$a/\sqrt{2} = \Delta h/4$; hence $a = \Delta h\, \sqrt{2}/4 =
\Delta h/(2\sqrt{2})$ using $\sqrt{2}^{\,2} = 2$.
nodes.lean_source:
lemma side_length_eq_delta_h_over (hp : 0 < rho0) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hΔ : 0 < DeltaH) (hg : 0 < g)
    (hbal : rho0 * g * a ^ 4 / Real.sqrt 2 = rho0 * g * DeltaH * a ^ 3 / 4) :
    a = DeltaH / (2 * Real.sqrt 2) := by
  sorry

nodes.title: Numerical readout at $\Delta h = 1.41$
nodes.statement:
For the design value $\Delta h = 1.41$ and $a = \Delta h/(2\sqrt{2})$, the
final readout is $a = 0.50 \;\lor\; |a - 0.50| < 1/200$.
nodes.proof_tex:
The closed form gives $1.41/(2\sqrt{2}) = 0.4984\ldots$; the rational bounds
$1.414 < \sqrt{2} < 1.415$ place this value within $1/200$ of $0.50$.
nodes.lean_source:
lemma numerical_value (hp : 0 < rho0) (ha : 0 < a) (hg : 0 < g)
    (hΔ : DeltaH = 1.41)
    (ha_eq : a = DeltaH / (2 * Real.sqrt 2)) :
    a = 0.50 ∨ |a - 0.50| < 1 / 200 := by
  sorry

nodes.title: Balance-law consistency bridge
nodes.statement:
The torque-balance existential bundled in the gate setup, re-expressed with
the derived magnitudes: a critical torque balance holds between the pressure
couple magnitude and the net immersed weight.
nodes.proof_tex:
Project the torque-balance field of the setup bundle and identify its force
and couple with the defined magnitudes; no new physical input enters.
nodes.lean_source:
lemma torque_balance_contract (S : HydrostaticGateSetup)
    (hbal : restoringMoment = pressureCoupleMagnitude) :
    IsCriticalTorqueBalance pressureCoupleMagnitude netImmersedWeight := by
  sorry

nodes.title: T1-A1 target: the gate side length
nodes.statement:
For the hydrostatic gate of Figure 1a in its critical (maximum-$\Delta h$)
configuration, with $\Delta h = 1.41$ m and the moment balance about O
holding, the side length of the cubic block is
$a = \Delta h/(2\sqrt{2})$ with $|a - 0.50| < 1/200$ — the official answer
$0.50$ m at the stated precision, appearing here conclusion-side only.
nodes.proof_tex:
Positivity of $\rho_0$, $a$, $\Delta h$, $g$ comes from the parameter regime
inside the setup bundle. The consistency bridge re-expresses the bundled
balance as restoring moment equals pressure couple; Steps 5 and 7 turn this
into the scalar balance equation and solve it to $a = \Delta h/(2\sqrt{2})$.
The numerical readout at $\Delta h = 1.41$ then yields the neighbourhood of
$0.50$; the equality alternative trivially implies the bound since
$0 < 1/200$.
nodes.lean_source:
theorem hydrostatic_gate_side_length_a_target (S : HydrostaticGateSetup)
    (hΔ : DeltaH = 1.41)
    (hbal : restoringMoment = pressureCoupleMagnitude) :
    a = DeltaH / (2 * Real.sqrt 2) ∧ |a - 0.50| < 1 / 200 := by
  sorry

nodes.title: Scattering plane, dot product, and perpendicular bracket
nodes.statement:
The ambient centre-of-mass plane $\mathrm{Plane} = \mathbb{R}^2$ (the
Euclidean space on $\mathrm{Fin}\ 2$) on which the relative motion lives,
with the standard scalar product $\langle v, w\rangle = v_x w_x + v_y w_y$
and the oriented planar bracket $\mathrm{perp}\ v\ w = v_x w_y - v_y w_x$ --
the signed $z$-component of the 2D cross product, positive exactly when $w$
is reached from $v$ by a counterclockwise rotation of less than
$180^{\circ}$.  The bracket carries the rotation sense of the deflection
(branch/orientation bookkeeping) and the planar angular momentum.
nodes.lean_source:
abbrev Plane := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)

def dot (v w : Plane) : ℝ := v 0 * w 0 + v 1 * w 1

def perp (v w : Plane) : ℝ := v 0 * w 1 - v 1 * w 0

opaque particleMass : ℝ

opaque hbar : ℝ

opaque coulombK : ℝ

opaque elementaryCharge : ℝ

opaque bohrRadius : ℝ

nodes.title: Universal constants of the scenario
nodes.statement:
The fixed physical constants, kept abstract (opaque) so that nothing about
the target can be obtained by unfolding: the inertial mass $m$ of each
particle (electron and positron, kg), the reduced Planck constant $\hbar$
(J\,s), the Coulomb constant $k = 1/(4\pi\varepsilon_0)$
(N\,m$^2$\,C$^{-2}$), the elementary charge
magnitude $e$ (the electron carries $-e$, the positron $+e$; C), and the
Bohr radius $a_0 = 4\pi\varepsilon_0\hbar^2/(m e^2) = \hbar^2/(k m e^2)$
(m).

nodes.title: Scaling regime certificates
nodes.statement:
The positivity certificates for all constants, $m, \hbar, k, e, a_0 > 0$,
together with the defining Bohr-radius identity
$a_0 = \hbar^2/(k\,m\,e^2)$ (the page's
$a_0 = 4\pi\varepsilon_0\hbar^2/(m e^2)$ with $k = 1/(4\pi\varepsilon_0)$),
packaged as a single hypothesis structure carried by everything downstream.
nodes.lean_source:
structure ScalingRegime : Prop where
  particleMass_pos : 0 < particleMass
  hbar_pos : 0 < hbar
  coulombK_pos : 0 < coulombK
  elementaryCharge_pos : 0 < elementaryCharge
  bohrRadius_pos : 0 < bohrRadius
  bohr_radius_def : bohrRadius = hbar ^ 2 / (coulombK * particleMass * elementaryCharge ^ 2)

nodes.title: Angular-momentum factor predicate
nodes.statement:
The predicate on a real $\mu$ asserting $\mu > 0$, i.e.\ that $\mu$ is a
legitimate dimensionless factor making the per-particle angular momentum
$\mu\hbar$ about the centre of mass positive.
nodes.lean_source:
def IsAngularMomentumFactor (μ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 < μ

nodes.title: The unbound-case value $\mu = 15/2$
nodes.statement: The value $\mu = 15/2$ of subquestion B.2 (the unbound, hyperbolic case).
nodes.lean_source: def unboundMu : ℝ := 15 / 2

nodes.title: $15/2$ is an angular-momentum factor
nodes.statement: $\mathrm{IsAngularMomentumFactor}(15/2)$ holds.
nodes.proof_tex: Unfold both definitions; $15/2 > 0$ by arithmetic.
nodes.lean_source:
theorem unboundMu_isAngularMomentumFactor : IsAngularMomentumFactor unboundMu := by
  norm_num [unboundMu, IsAngularMomentumFactor]

nodes.title: Two-body Coulomb scattering data
nodes.statement:
The B.1-style two-body record of the isolated, classical, non-relativistic
electron--positron pair with purely electrostatic interaction, with the
two-body-to-one-body reduction encoded.  Data: the CM-frame relative
curve $\mathrm{sep} : \mathbb{R} \to \mathrm{Plane}$
($r_{e+}(t) - r_{e-}(t)$, m), initial data ($r_0 = 100\,a_0$, antiparallel
CM velocities $\pm v_0$ perpendicular to the separation with the Fig.-1b
orientation $\mathrm{perp}\ \mathrm{sep0}\ v_0 = r_0 v_0$, relative speed
$2v_0$, per-particle angular momentum $\mu\hbar$ certified by
$m v_0 (r_0/2) = \mu \hbar$), the reduced mass $m_{\mathrm{red}} = m/2$,
the total angular momentum $L = 2\mu\hbar$ and total energy $E$, and a
continuous polar angle.  Governing-law fields: Coulomb's law for the
conserved energy, Newton's equation for the reduced particle under the
attractive Coulomb force, angular-momentum conservation
$\mathrm{perp}(\mathrm{sep}, \dot{\mathrm{sep}}) = L/m_{\mathrm{red}}$, the
radial-energy identity multiplied out by $r^2 > 0$, the turning point at
$t = 0$ (radial speed zero), twice-continuous-differentiable regularity,
and $\mathrm{sep}\,t \neq 0$ for all $t$.  No orbit shape, asymptotic
velocity, or deflection angle appears among the fields; those are
conclusion-side.
nodes.lean_source:
structure CoulombScatteringData (hR : ScalingRegime) where

  sep : ℝ → Plane

  sep0 : Plane

  v0 : Plane

  polar_angle : ℝ → ℝ

  reduced_mass : ℝ

  total_angular_momentum : ℝ

  total_energy : ℝ

  initial_separation : ℝ

  initial_speed : ℝ

  sep_ne_zero : ∀ t : ℝ, sep t ≠ 0

  smooth_sep : ContDiff ℝ 2 sep

  initial_instant : sep 0 = sep0 ∧ deriv sep 0 = (2 : ℝ) • v0

  reduced_mass_eq : reduced_mass = particleMass / 2

  initial_separation_value : initial_separation = 100 * bohrRadius

  initial_separation_is_norm : ‖sep0‖ = initial_separation

  initial_speed_value : v0 ≠ 0 ∧ ‖v0‖ = initial_speed

  angular_momentum_per_particle :
    particleMass * initial_speed * (initial_separation / 2) = unboundMu * hbar

  total_angular_momentum_eq :
    total_angular_momentum =
      2 * (particleMass * initial_speed * (initial_separation / 2))

  initial_transverse :
    perp sep0 v0 = initial_separation * initial_speed

  polar_decomposition :
    ∀ t : ℝ, sep t 0 = ‖sep t‖ * Real.cos (polar_angle t) ∧
      sep t 1 = ‖sep t‖ * Real.sin (polar_angle t)

  angular_momentum_law :
    ∀ t : ℝ, perp (sep t) (deriv sep t) = total_angular_momentum / reduced_mass

  relative_kinetic_law :
    2 * ((1 / 2) * particleMass * initial_speed ^ 2) =
      (1 / 2) * reduced_mass * (2 * initial_speed) ^ 2

  coulomb_law :
    total_energy =
      2 * ((1 / 2) * particleMass * initial_speed ^ 2) -
        coulombK * elementaryCharge ^ 2 / initial_separation

  newton_relative_law :
    ∀ t : ℝ, ‖(1 / 2 : ℝ) • (deriv (deriv sep)) t‖ =
      coulombK * elementaryCharge ^ 2 / ‖sep t‖ ^ 2

  radial_energy_law :
    ∀ t : ℝ,
      total_energy * ‖sep t‖ ^ 2 +
          coulombK * elementaryCharge ^ 2 * ‖sep t‖ -
        total_angular_momentum ^ 2 / (2 * reduced_mass) =
      (1 / 2) * reduced_mass * (deriv (fun s => ‖sep s‖) t * ‖sep t‖) ^ 2

  turning_point_initial : deriv (fun s => ‖sep s‖) 0 = 0

nodes.title: Initial separation is positive
nodes.statement: The Fig.-1b readout satisfies $0 < r_0$.
nodes.proof_tex:
Rewrite $r_0 = 100\,a_0$; the product $100 \cdot a_0$ is positive since
$a_0 > 0$.
nodes.lean_source:
theorem initial_separation_pos : 0 < S.initial_separation := by
  rw [S.initial_separation_value]
  exact mul_pos (by norm_num) hR.bohrRadius_pos

nodes.title: Total angular momentum value
nodes.statement:
The total angular momentum has the value $L = 2\,(\mu\hbar) = 15\hbar$ for
$\mu = 15/2$.
nodes.proof_tex:
Rewrite $L$ by its defining field as twice the per-particle contribution,
then substitute the given identity $m v_0 (r_0/2) = \mu\hbar$.
nodes.lean_source:
theorem total_angular_momentum_value :
    S.total_angular_momentum = 2 * (unboundMu * hbar) := by
  rw [S.total_angular_momentum_eq, S.angular_momentum_per_particle]

nodes.title: Turning-point quadratic
nodes.statement:
The effective radial quadratic
$Q(r) = E r^2 + k e^2 r - L^2/(2 m_{\mathrm{red}})$: along the trajectory
the radial-energy identity gives
$Q(r) = \tfrac{1}{2} m_{\mathrm{red}}\, \dot r^{\,2} r^2$, so $Q(r) = 0$
exactly at turning points.

nodes.title: Periapsis at the initial separation
nodes.statement:
The initial separation is a turning point (the periapsis of the unbound
orbit): $Q(r_0) = 0$.
nodes.proof_tex:
Evaluate the radial-energy law at $t = 0$: $\mathrm{sep}\,0 = \mathrm{sep0}$
has norm $r_0$ and the radial speed vanishes there, so the right-hand side
is zero; unfold $Q$ and read off the equality.
nodes.lean_source:
theorem turningQuadratic_periapsis : S.turningQuadratic S.initial_separation = 0 := by
  have h1 := S.radial_energy_law 0
  rw [S.initial_instant.1, S.turning_point_initial, S.initial_separation_is_norm,
    zero_mul, zero_pow (two_ne_zero : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0), mul_zero] at h1
  rw [CoulombScatteringData.turningQuadratic]
  exact h1

nodes.title: Semilatus rectum
nodes.statement:
The semilatus rectum $p = L^2/(m_{\mathrm{red}}\,k\,e^2)$ of the reduced
one-body problem (m): the geometric scale of the conic in Hint 2.

nodes.title: Squared eccentricity
nodes.statement:
The dimensionless squared eccentricity
$\varepsilon^2 = 1 + 2 E L^2/(m_{\mathrm{red}} (k e^2)^2)$; for equal
masses $m_{\mathrm{red}} = m/2$ reconciles the denominator with the page's
Hint-1 form $\varepsilon^2 = 1 + 4 E L^2/(k^2 e^4 m)$.

nodes.title: Positivity of the total energy (unboundness)
nodes.statement:
For $\mu = 15/2$ the total energy is the Fig.-1b value
$E = \mu^2/2500 - 1/200$ in units of $\hbar^2/(m a_0^2)$, i.e.\
$E = 7/400 > 0$: the pair is unbound (hyperbolic scattering).
nodes.proof_tex:
Evaluate the energy law at $t = 0$: by the transverse configuration the
energy is kinetic plus Coulomb,
$E = 2\cdot\tfrac12 m v_0^2 - k e^2/r_0$; eliminate $v_0$ via
$m v_0 (r_0/2) = \mu\hbar$ with $r_0 = 100\,a_0$ and the Bohr-radius identity
$a_0 = \hbar^2/(k m e^2)$, giving
$E = (\mu^2/2500 - 1/200)\,\hbar^2/(m a_0^2) = 7/400 > 0$ in those units.
Pure algebra; no angle content.
nodes.lean_source:
theorem total_energy_pos {hR : ScalingRegime} (S : CoulombScatteringData hR)
    (hμ : IsAngularMomentumFactor unboundMu) : 0 < S.total_energy := by
  sorry

nodes.title: Eccentricity exceeds one
nodes.statement:
At $\mu = 15/2$ the squared eccentricity strictly exceeds $1$: the conic is
a hyperbola, not an ellipse.
nodes.proof_tex:
The added Hint-1 term $2 E L^2/(m_{\mathrm{red}} (k e^2)^2)$ is a quotient
of positive quantities: $E > 0$
(\cref{thm:IPhO2026Problems_problem_IPhO_2026_1_B_2:total_energy_pos}),
$m_{\mathrm{red}} = m/2 > 0$, $L = 15\hbar \neq 0$, and $k, e > 0$; hence
$\varepsilon^2 = 1 + (\text{positive}) > 1$.
nodes.lean_source:
theorem eccentricity_gt_one {hR : ScalingRegime} (S : CoulombScatteringData hR)
    (hμ : IsAngularMomentumFactor unboundMu) : 1 < S.eccentricitySq := by
  have hE : 0 < S.total_energy := total_energy_pos S hμ
  have hm : 0 < S.reduced_mass := by
    rw [S.reduced_mass_eq]
    exact div_pos hR.particleMass_pos (by norm_num)
  have hL : S.total_angular_momentum ≠ 0 := by
    rw [S.total_angular_momentum_value]
    exact mul_ne_zero (by norm_num)
      (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num [unboundMu]) (ne_of_gt hR.hbar_pos))
  have hke : coulombK * elementaryCharge ^ 2 ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hR.coulombK_pos)
      (pow_ne_zero 2 (ne_of_gt hR.elementaryCharge_pos))
  have hpos :
      0 < 2 * S.total_energy * S.total_angular_momentum ^ 2 /
        (S.reduced_mass * (coulombK * elementaryCharge ^ 2) ^ 2) :=
    div_pos (mul_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) hE) (sq_pos_of_ne_zero hL))
      (mul_pos hm (sq_pos_of_ne_zero hke))
  have hdef : S.eccentricitySq =
      1 + 2 * S.total_energy * S.total_angular_momentum ^ 2 /
        (S.reduced_mass * (coulombK * elementaryCharge ^ 2) ^ 2) := rfl
  rw [hdef]
  linarith

nodes.title: Eccentricity value (Hint 1, derivable)
nodes.statement:
Evaluation of the official Hint-1 formula for this scenario:
$\varepsilon^2 = 67/4$ (so $\varepsilon = \sqrt{67}/2 > 1$).  This is the
page's first hint recorded as a \emph{derivable bridge lemma}, not an
assumed law; it is conclusion-free of angle data.
nodes.proof_tex:
From the same laws as
\cref{thm:IPhO2026Problems_problem_IPhO_2026_1_B_2:total_energy_pos}:
substitute $E = 7/400$ (in units $\hbar^2/(m a_0^2)$), $L = 15\hbar$,
$m_{\mathrm{red}} = m/2$, and the Bohr-radius identity into
$1 + 2 E L^2/(m_{\mathrm{red}}(k e^2)^2)$; the units cancel and the
rational arithmetic gives $67/4$.
nodes.lean_source:
theorem eccentricity_sq_eq {hR : ScalingRegime} (S : CoulombScatteringData hR)
    (hμ : IsAngularMomentumFactor unboundMu) : S.eccentricitySq = 67 / 4 := by
  sorry

nodes.title: Polar conic form of the orbit (Hint 2, derivable)
nodes.statement:
The page's second hint as a derivable bridge: the trajectory
$r = \lVert \mathrm{sep}\,t \rVert$ as a function of its own polar angle
$\theta(t)$ is a conic -- there exist $\varepsilon = \sqrt{\varepsilon^2} > 1$
and a symmetry-axis direction $\theta_0$ (a priori unknown) such that for
all $t$, $\varepsilon\cos(\theta(t) - \theta_0) - 1 > 0$ and
$r = p/(\varepsilon\cos(\theta(t) - \theta_0) - 1)$ (the periapsis branch
of the page's form $r = a/(1 - \varepsilon\cos\theta)$ up to the axis
orientation).
nodes.proof_tex:
Set $u = 1/r$; angular-momentum conservation
$\dot\theta = L/(m_{\mathrm{red}} r^2)$
turns Newton's radial equation into Binet's linear equation
$u'' + u = m_{\mathrm{red}} k e^2/L^2$, whose solution with the periapsis
initial condition (radial speed zero at $t = 0$,
\cref{lem:IPhO2026Problems_problem_IPhO_2026_1_B_2:turningQuadratic_periapsis})
is $u = p^{-1}(\varepsilon\cos(\theta - \theta_0) - 1)$ with
$p = L^2/(m_{\mathrm{red}} k e^2)$ and $\varepsilon$ matching
\cref{def:IPhO2026Problems_problem_IPhO_2026_1_B_2:eccentricitySq};
the unboundness $\varepsilon > 1$
(\cref{lem:IPhO2026Problems_problem_IPhO_2026_1_B_2:eccentricity_gt_one})
selects the physical branch with positive denominator.
nodes.lean_source:
theorem orbit_eq_conic {hR : ScalingRegime} (S : CoulombScatteringData hR)
    (hμ : IsAngularMomentumFactor unboundMu) :
    ∃ eps θ0 : ℝ, eps = Real.sqrt S.eccentricitySq ∧ 1 < eps ∧
      ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < eps * Real.cos (S.polar_angle t - θ0) - 1 ∧
        ‖S.sep t‖ =
          S.semilatusRectum / (eps * Real.cos (S.polar_angle t - θ0) - 1) := by
  sorry

nodes.title: Initial line of motion of the positron
nodes.statement:
The initial line of motion of $e^+$: the unit vector
$\hat u_0 = \lVert v_0 \rVert^{-1} v_0$ along the initial positron velocity
(Fig. 1b) -- the reference direction of the asked angle.
nodes.lean_source:
noncomputable def initialDirection {hR : ScalingRegime} (S : CoulombScatteringData hR) : Plane :=
  ‖S.v0‖⁻¹ • S.v0

nodes.title: Candidate relative-velocity vector
nodes.statement:
A planar vector record (single plane-vector field, m/s): plain data to
which the predicate
\cref{def:IPhO2026Problems_problem_IPhO_2026_1_B_2:IsAsymptoticRelativeVelocity}
then assigns the physical role of $u_\infty$.
nodes.lean_source:
structure RelativeVelocityVector where

  vec : Plane

nodes.title: Asymptotic relative velocity predicate
nodes.statement:
The predicate assigning $u_\infty$ its physical role: the candidate vector
is a nonzero planar vector that is the limit of the relative velocity
$\dot{\mathrm{sep}}\,t$ as $t \to +\infty$ (energy conservation keeps the
speed bounded, so future time infinity and infinite separation coincide
for the unbound orbit), together with the figure/body branch assumption:
the deflection bends the trajectory toward the line connecting the pair
(clockwise in the Fig.-1b orientation), recorded as
$\mathrm{perp}\ \hat u_0\ u_\infty \le 0$.  The limit condition pins
down at most one vector, so existence is a theorem to be proved, not an
assumption.
nodes.lean_source:
structure IsAsymptoticRelativeVelocity {hR : ScalingRegime}
    (S : CoulombScatteringData hR) (u : RelativeVelocityVector) : Prop where

  tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (deriv S.sep) Filter.atTop (nhds u.vec)

  u_inf_ne_zero : u.vec ≠ 0

  direction_toward_pair : perp (initialDirection (S := S)) u.vec ≤ 0

nodes.title: Existence of the asymptotic relative velocity
nodes.statement:
For the unbound orbit ($\mu = 15/2$, $E > 0$) there is a well-defined
asymptotic relative velocity of $e^+$ with respect to $e^-$ on the outward
(post-periapsis) hyperbolic branch.
nodes.proof_tex:
The conic form
(\cref{thm:IPhO2026Problems_problem_IPhO_2026_1_B_2:orbit_eq_conic}) makes
$\theta(t)$ tend to the asymptote angle as $r \to \infty$ on the outward
branch, while energy conservation
(\cref{thm:IPhO2026Problems_problem_IPhO_2026_1_B_2:total_energy_pos})
fixes the limiting speed $\sqrt{2E/m_{\mathrm{red}}} \neq 0$; the velocity
vectors converge to that speed times the asymptote direction, and the
Fig.-1b rolling branch gives the nonpositive bracket.
nodes.lean_source:
theorem exists_asymptoticRelativeVelocity {hR : ScalingRegime}
    (S : CoulombScatteringData hR) (hμ : IsAngularMomentumFactor unboundMu) :
    ∃ u : RelativeVelocityVector, IsAsymptoticRelativeVelocity S u := by
  sorry

nodes.title: Angle between planar vectors
nodes.statement:
The angle between two planar vectors,
$\arccos\!\big(\langle a, b\rangle / (\lVert a \rVert \lVert b
\rVert)\big) \in [0, \pi]$.
nodes.lean_source:
noncomputable def angleBetween (a b : Plane) : ℝ :=
  Real.arccos (dot a b / (‖a‖ * ‖b‖))

nodes.title: Deflection magnitude and formula
nodes.statement:
Any asymptotic relative velocity satisfies
$\lVert u_\infty \rVert = \sqrt{2E/m_{\mathrm{red}}}$ and
$\mathrm{angleBetween}\ \hat u_0\ u_\infty
= \pi - 2\arctan\!\big(1/\sqrt{\varepsilon^2 - 1}\big)$.
Contains the sign/orientation input but no numeric deflection value.
nodes.proof_tex:
The magnitude follows from the energy law at infinity, where the Coulomb
term vanishes and $E = \tfrac12 m_{\mathrm{red}} \lVert u_\infty \rVert^2$.
For the direction, the hyperbola of
\cref{thm:IPhO2026Problems_problem_IPhO_2026_1_B_2:orbit_eq_conic} with
$\varepsilon > 1$ has asymptote directions making the acute angle
$\arctan\sqrt{\varepsilon^2 - 1}$ with the symmetry axis; traversed outward
from periapsis, the total change of direction between the incoming line and
the outgoing asymptote is
$\pi - 2\arctan\!\big(1/\sqrt{\varepsilon^2-1}\big)$, read off on the
branch side recorded in
\cref{def:IPhO2026Problems_problem_IPhO_2026_1_B_2:IsAsymptoticRelativeVelocity}.
nodes.lean_source:
theorem signed_deflection_eq_formula {hR : ScalingRegime}
    (S : CoulombScatteringData hR) (u : RelativeVelocityVector)
    (hu : IsAsymptoticRelativeVelocity S u)
    (hμ : IsAngularMomentumFactor unboundMu) :
    ‖u.vec‖ = Real.sqrt (2 * S.total_energy / S.reduced_mass) ∧
      angleBetween (initialDirection (S := S)) u.vec =
        Real.pi - 2 * Real.arctan (1 / Real.sqrt (S.eccentricitySq - 1)) := by
  sorry

nodes.title: Signed deflection
nodes.statement:
The oriented (signed) deflection angle of the scattering, in radians:
$\pm\, \mathrm{angleBetween}\ \hat u_0\ u_\infty$ with sign $+1$ when the
deflection is counterclockwise from the initial line of motion of $e^+$
($0 \le \mathrm{perp}\ \hat u_0\ u_\infty$) and $-1$ when clockwise.  The
Fig.-1b orientation selects the clockwise case.
nodes.lean_source:
noncomputable def signedDeflection {hR : ScalingRegime}
    (S : CoulombScatteringData hR) (u : RelativeVelocityVector) : ℝ :=
  (if 0 ≤ perp (initialDirection (S := S)) u.vec then (1 : ℝ) else -1) *
    angleBetween (initialDirection (S := S)) u.vec

nodes.title: Radians to degrees
nodes.statement: The conversion $\theta \mapsto \theta \cdot 180/\pi$.
nodes.lean_source: noncomputable def radiansToDegrees (θ : ℝ) : ℝ := θ * (180 / Real.pi)

nodes.title: Branch sign: signed deflection is the negated angle
nodes.statement:
Under the strict Fig.-1b branch condition
$\mathrm{perp}\ \hat u_0\ u_\infty < 0$, the signed deflection satisfies
$\mathrm{signedDeflection}\ u = -\mathrm{angleBetween}\ \hat u_0\ u_\infty$.
nodes.proof_tex:
Unfold the definition; the strict negativity is precisely the failing
condition of the sign test, so the $-1$ branch is selected and the formula
becomes the negation.  (The degenerate zero-deflection case is excluded by
the physics side: the branch condition together with the nonzero
deflection from
\cref{thm:IPhO2026Problems_problem_IPhO_2026_1_B_2:signed_deflection_eq_formula}
makes the remaining branch strict.)
nodes.lean_source:
theorem signedDeflection_eq_neg_angle {hR : ScalingRegime}
    (S : CoulombScatteringData hR) (u : RelativeVelocityVector)
    (_hu : IsAsymptoticRelativeVelocity S u)
    (hnondeg : perp (initialDirection (S := S)) u.vec < 0) :
    signedDeflection (S := S) u =
      -angleBetween (initialDirection (S := S)) u.vec := by
  unfold signedDeflection
  rw [if_neg (not_le.mpr hnondeg)]
  ring

nodes.title: Rounding band for the official signed value
nodes.statement:
The predicate on a real $x$ asserting that $x$ rounds to the official
printed value $-16.60$ degrees in the sense of the official marking scheme:
$-16.605 \le x < -16.595$.
nodes.lean_source:
def roundsToOfficialDegrees (x : ℝ) : Prop :=
  -(16605 : ℝ) / 1000 ≤ x ∧ x < -(16595 : ℝ) / 1000

nodes.title: Main target: signed deflection angle (T1-B2)
nodes.statement:
Under the two-body Coulomb model of Fig. 1b with $\mu = 15/2$ (unbound
case), there exists an asymptotic relative velocity $u_\infty$ of $e^+$
with respect to $e^-$, and its signed deflection $\delta$ from the initial
line of motion of $e^+$ equals the exact value
$-(\pi - 2\arctan(2/\sqrt{63}))$ radians, whose degree reading rounds to
the official $-16.60$ degrees -- the negative sign being the official
``$16.60$ degrees below the initial line of motion''.  The recorded
official value first appears here, conclusion-side.
nodes.proof_tex:
Existence of $u_\infty$ is
\cref{thm:IPhO2026Problems_problem_IPhO_2026_1_B_2:exists_asymptoticRelativeVelocity}.
The formula
\cref{thm:IPhO2026Problems_problem_IPhO_2026_1_B_2:signed_deflection_eq_formula}
with $\varepsilon^2 = 67/4$
(\cref{thm:IPhO2026Problems_problem_IPhO_2026_1_B_2:eccentricity_sq_eq})
and the asymptote factor $2/\sqrt{63}$
(\cref{lem:IPhO2026Problems_problem_IPhO_2026_1_B_2:asymptote_factor_certificate})
gives the unsigned angle $\pi - 2\arctan(2/\sqrt{63})$.  The deflection is
nonzero, so the branch condition sharpens to
$\mathrm{perp}\ \hat u_0\ u_\infty < 0$ and
\cref{lem:IPhO2026Problems_problem_IPhO_2026_1_B_2:signedDeflection_eq_neg_angle}
attaches the negative sign.  Converting by
\cref{def:IPhO2026Problems_problem_IPhO_2026_1_B_2:radiansToDegrees} gives
$-(\pi - 2\arctan(2/\sqrt{63})) \cdot 180/\pi \approx -16.60$, which lies
in $[-16.605, -16.595)$ and hence rounds to $-16.60$ by
\cref{def:IPhO2026Problems_problem_IPhO_2026_1_B_2:roundsToOfficialDegrees}.
nodes.lean_source:
theorem signed_deflection_angle_T1_B2 {hR : ScalingRegime}
    (S : CoulombScatteringData hR) (hμ : IsAngularMomentumFactor unboundMu) :
    ∃ u : RelativeVelocityVector, ∃ delta : ℝ,
      IsAsymptoticRelativeVelocity S u ∧
        delta = signedDeflection (S := S) u ∧
        delta = -(Real.pi - 2 * Real.arctan (2 / Real.sqrt 63)) ∧
        roundsToOfficialDegrees (radiansToDegrees delta) := by
  sorry

nodes.title: Asymptote factor certificate
nodes.statement:
The hyperbola $\varepsilon^2 = 67/4$ makes the scattering asymptote factor
$1/\sqrt{\varepsilon^2 - 1} = 1/\sqrt{67/4 - 1} = 2/\sqrt{63}$.
nodes.proof_tex:
$67/4 - 1 = 63/4 = (\sqrt{63}/2)^2$ using $\sqrt{63}^{\,2} = 63$; taking
the positive square root gives $\sqrt{63/4} = \sqrt{63}/2$, and inverting
yields $2/\sqrt{63}$.  Pure algebra up to that square-root identity.
nodes.lean_source:
theorem asymptote_factor_certificate :
    1 / Real.sqrt ((67 / 4 : ℝ) - 1) = 2 / Real.sqrt 63 := by
  have h634 : (63 / 4 : ℝ) = (Real.sqrt 63 / 2) ^ 2 := by
    rw [div_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)]
    norm_num
  have halg : (67 / 4 : ℝ) - 1 = 63 / 4 := by norm_num
  rw [halg, h634, Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)]
  field_simp

nodes.title: Rounding band for the official magnitude
nodes.statement:
The predicate on a real $x$ asserting that $x$ rounds to the official
printed magnitude $16.60$ degrees: $16.595 \le x < 16.615$.
nodes.lean_source:
def roundsToOfficialDegreesAbs (x : ℝ) : Prop :=
  (16595 : ℝ) / 1000 ≤ x ∧ x < (16615 : ℝ) / 1000

nodes.title: Magnitude corollary: unsigned deflection in degrees
nodes.statement:
The unsigned deflection angle between $u_\infty$ and the initial line of
motion of $e^+$ equals the exact value $\pi - 2\arctan(2/\sqrt{63})$
radians, whose degree reading rounds to the official $16.60$ degrees
below the initial line of motion.
nodes.proof_tex:
Take $u_\infty$ from
\cref{thm:IPhO2026Problems_problem_IPhO_2026_1_B_2:exists_asymptoticRelativeVelocity};
\cref{thm:IPhO2026Problems_problem_IPhO_2026_1_B_2:signed_deflection_eq_formula}
with $\varepsilon^2 = 67/4$
(\cref{thm:IPhO2026Problems_problem_IPhO_2026_1_B_2:eccentricity_sq_eq})
and the factor $2/\sqrt{63}$
(\cref{lem:IPhO2026Problems_problem_IPhO_2026_1_B_2:asymptote_factor_certificate})
identify the angle; its degree reading lies in $[16.595, 16.615)$, so it
rounds to $16.60$ by
\cref{def:IPhO2026Problems_problem_IPhO_2026_1_B_2:roundsToOfficialDegreesAbs}.
nodes.lean_source:
theorem unsigned_deflection_angle_in_degrees_T1_B2 {hR : ScalingRegime}
    (S : CoulombScatteringData hR) (hμ : IsAngularMomentumFactor unboundMu) :
    ∃ u : RelativeVelocityVector,
      IsAsymptoticRelativeVelocity S u ∧
        angleBetween (initialDirection (S := S)) u.vec =
          Real.pi - 2 * Real.arctan (2 / Real.sqrt 63) ∧
        roundsToOfficialDegreesAbs
          (radiansToDegrees (angleBetween (initialDirection (S := S)) u.vec)) := by
  sorry

nodes.title: Physics formalization target
nodes.statement: The assigned autoformalize agent should translate this physics problem into Lean declarations in the covered file, with theorem and lemma proof bodies written as `by sorry`.
nodes.proof_tex: This is an autoformalization task, not a proof task. Produce faithful statements that can later be proved without weakening the source contract.

nodes.title: Dissociation energy gap
nodes.statement:
The dissociation gap of the ozone breakup, $\Delta U = U_f - U_i$: the
difference of the ground-state energy of the fragments $O_2 + O$ and of
the ozone molecule $O_3$, which are opaque constants of the formalization.
nodes.proof_tex: Definition; no claim.
nodes.lean_source:
def dissociationEnergyGap : ℝ :=
  fragmentsGroundStateEnergy - ozoneGroundStateEnergy

nodes.title: Positive-constant regime
nodes.statement:
The physical regime of the problem: the reduced Planck constant $\hbar$,
the speed of light $c$, and the oxygen-atom mass $m$ are positive, and the
dissociation is endothermic, $\Delta U > 0$.
nodes.proof_tex: Definition; no claim.
nodes.lean_source:
structure ConstantRegime : Prop where
  hbar_pos : 0 < hbar
  speedOfLight_pos : 0 < speedOfLight
  oxygenAtomMass_pos : 0 < oxygenAtomMass

  gap_pos : 0 < dissociationEnergyGap

nodes.title: Reaction plane
nodes.statement:
The plane containing the incident photon and the outgoing fragments of
Figure~1c, modelled as an abstract two-dimensional real Euclidean space so
that the angle between momentum vectors is intrinsic.
nodes.proof_tex: Definition; no claim.
nodes.lean_source: abbrev ReactionPlane : Type := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)

nodes.title: Incident photon line
nodes.statement:
The direction of the incident photon (and of its momentum) in the reaction
plane: a vector $\hat{k}$ certified to be a unit vector,
$\|\hat{k}\| = 1$.
nodes.proof_tex: Definition; no claim.
nodes.lean_source:
structure PhotonLine where
  direction : ReactionPlane
  direction_unit : ‖direction‖ = 1

nodes.title: Scattering angle readout
nodes.statement:
The Figure-1c readout that $\theta$ is the angle between the outgoing
$O_2$ momentum $p$ and the incident photon direction $\hat{k}$: the
fragment is strictly outgoing, $p \neq 0$, and the cosine-law component
statement $\langle \hat{k}, p \rangle = \|p\| \cos\theta$ holds.
nodes.proof_tex: Definition; no claim.
nodes.lean_source:
def IsScatteringAngle (k : PhotonLine) (p : ReactionPlane) (θ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  p ≠ 0 ∧ @inner ℝ _ _ k.direction p = ‖p‖ * Real.cos θ

nodes.title: Angular range of the problem
nodes.statement:
The figure range of the scattering angle: $\theta \in [0, \pi]$.  Branch
information is preserved by hypothesis, not selected in conclusions.
nodes.proof_tex: Definition; no claim.
nodes.lean_source:
def IsAngularRange (θ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  θ ∈ Icc 0 Real.pi

nodes.title: Forward branch
nodes.statement:
The forward, non-backscattering branch of the official solution:
$\theta \le \pi/2$, the branch in which the tangent-line critical
configuration of Figure~1c exists.
nodes.proof_tex: Definition; no claim.
nodes.lean_source:
def IsForwardBranch (θ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  θ ≤ Real.pi / 2

nodes.title: Lawful two-body dissociation
nodes.statement:
The governing-law structure of the absorption and two-body breakup
$\gamma + O_3 \to O_2 + O$ at photon angular frequency $\omega$: vector
momentum conservation fixes the oxygen-atom momentum
$q = (\hbar\omega/c)\,\hat{k} - p$; its eliminated cosine-law shadow is
$\|q\|^2 = (\hbar\omega/c)^2 + \|p\|^2 - 2(\hbar\omega/c)\,\|p\|\cos\theta$;
$\theta$ is the Figure-1c scattering angle; and non-relativistic energy
balance reads $\hbar\omega = \Delta U + \|p\|^2/(2\cdot 2m) + \|q\|^2/(2m)$
with fragment masses $2m$ and $m$.  No field mentions the threshold value.
nodes.proof_tex: Definition; no claim.
nodes.lean_source:
structure IsTwoBodyDissociation
    (k : PhotonLine) (ω θ m dU : ℝ) (p q : ReactionPlane) : Prop where

  momentum_q_sq :
    ‖q‖ ^ 2 = (hbar * ω / speedOfLight) ^ 2 + ‖p‖ ^ 2
      - 2 * (hbar * ω / speedOfLight) * ‖p‖ * Real.cos θ

  q_unique : q = (hbar * ω / speedOfLight) • k.direction - p

  angle_readout : IsScatteringAngle k p θ

  energy_balance :
    hbar * ω = dU + ‖p‖ ^ 2 / (2 * (2 * m)) + ‖q‖ ^ 2 / (2 * m)

nodes.title: Cosine-law elimination from vector momentum balance
nodes.statement:
If $q = (\hbar\omega/c)\,\hat{k} - p$ and $\theta$ is the scattering angle
between $\hat{k}$ and $p$, then
$\|q\|^2 = (\hbar\omega/c)^2 + \|p\|^2 - 2(\hbar\omega/c)\,\|p\|\cos\theta$:
the scalar magnitude field of the dissociation structure is a genuine
consequence of the vector law, not an independent modelling assumption.
nodes.proof_tex:
Expand $\|q\|^2 = \langle q, q \rangle$ with $q$ given by the vector
balance, use $\|\hat{k}\| = 1$ for the quadratic term, and insert the
readout $\langle \hat{k}, p \rangle = \|p\|\cos\theta$ for the cross term.
nodes.lean_source:
theorem momentum_q_sq_of_vector_balance
    (k : PhotonLine) (ω θ : ℝ) (p q : ReactionPlane)
    (hq : q = (hbar * ω / speedOfLight) • k.direction - p)
    (hθ : IsScatteringAngle k p θ) :
    ‖q‖ ^ 2 = (hbar * ω / speedOfLight) ^ 2 + ‖p‖ ^ 2
      - 2 * (hbar * ω / speedOfLight) * ‖p‖ * Real.cos θ := by
  sorry

nodes.title: Reachable frequency
nodes.statement:
A photon angular frequency $\omega$ is reachable at outgoing $O_2$ angle
$\theta$ (atom mass $m$, dissociation gap $\Delta U$) iff some lawful
dissociation configuration realizes that frequency: an existential over
photon directions and fragment momenta, not a formula.
nodes.proof_tex: Definition; no claim.
nodes.lean_source:
def ReachableFrequency (m dU θ ω : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (k : PhotonLine) (p q : ReactionPlane), IsTwoBodyDissociation k ω θ m dU p q

nodes.title: Dissociation threshold
nodes.statement:
$\omega_0$ is a dissociation threshold at angle $\theta$ iff it is
reachable and no strictly smaller positive frequency is reachable: a pure
minimality property that leaves the numerical value of the threshold open.
nodes.proof_tex: Definition; no claim.

nodes.title: Candidate threshold expression
nodes.statement:
The candidate closed-form forward-branch threshold
$\Omega(m, c, \Delta U, \theta)$ of the official solution, named as a bare
real-valued expression of the problem data (built from the angular factor
$2\sin^2\theta + 1$ and the square root of its discriminant).  By itself it
asserts nothing about dissociation; the claim that it \emph{is} the minimum
reachable frequency is the content of the target theorems below.
nodes.proof_tex: Definition; no claim.

nodes.title: Angular-factor identity
nodes.statement:
For every angle $\theta$, $2\sin^2\theta + 1 = 2 - \cos 2\theta$: the
angular factor of the threshold formula equals the coefficient appearing in
the official quadratic characterization.
nodes.proof_tex: The double-angle identity $\cos 2\theta = 1 - 2\sin^2\theta$ rearranged.
nodes.lean_source:
theorem two_sin_sq_add_one_eq (θ : ℝ) :
    2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2 + 1 = 2 - Real.cos (2 * θ) := by
  sorry

nodes.title: Quadratic characterization of the candidate threshold
nodes.statement:
For positive $m, c, \Delta U$, a forward angle $0 < \theta \le \pi/2$ with
nondegenerate angular factor $2 - \cos 2\theta \neq 0$ and a real square
root in the candidate formula, the scaled candidate
$E_0 = \hbar\,\Omega(m,c,\Delta U,\theta)$ is positive, solves
$(2 - \cos 2\theta)\,E^2 - 6 m c^2 E + 6\,\Delta U\,m c^2 = 0$,
and is smaller than every other positive root: it is the smallest positive
root of the official-solution quadratic.
nodes.proof_tex:
Rewrite $2\sin^2\theta + 1$ as $2 - \cos 2\theta$ via the angular-factor
identity, so the candidate becomes the root of the displayed quadratic in
$E = \hbar\omega$ selected by the minus sign of the quadratic formula;
positivity follows from the positive regime and the real square root, and
minimality among positive roots because the two roots are ordered by that
sign choice.
nodes.lean_source:
theorem quadratic_characterization_of_threshold
    (m c dU θ : ℝ)
    (hm : 0 < m) (hc : 0 < c) (hdU : 0 < dU)
    (hθ : IsForwardBranch θ) (hθpos : 0 < θ)
    (hfac : (2:ℝ) - Real.cos (2 * θ) ≠ 0)
    (hdisc : 0 ≤ 1 - (dU / (3 * m * c ^ 2)) * (2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2 + 1)) :
    let E₀ := hbar * hbarOmegaMin m c dU θ
    0 < E₀ ∧
      (2 - Real.cos (2 * θ)) * E₀ ^ 2 - 6 * m * c ^ 2 * E₀ + 6 * dU * m * c ^ 2 = 0 ∧
      ∀ E : ℝ, 0 < E →
        (2 - Real.cos (2 * θ)) * E ^ 2 - 6 * m * c ^ 2 * E + 6 * dU * m * c ^ 2 = 0 →
        E₀ ≤ E := by
  sorry

nodes.title: Minimum angular frequency, forward branch
nodes.statement:
In the positive-constant regime, for a nondegenerate forward angle
$0 < \theta \le \pi/2$ with a real square root, the candidate expression
\[
\Omega(m,c,\Delta U,\theta)
= \frac{3 m c^2 \left(1 - \sqrt{1 - \frac{\Delta U}{3 m c^2}\,(2\sin^2\theta + 1)}\right)}{\hbar\,(2\sin^2\theta + 1)}
\]
is the dissociation threshold at $\theta$: some lawful two-body
configuration realizes it, and no smaller positive frequency is reachable.
The recorded closed form appears strictly on the conclusion side; the
hypotheses carry only the physical regime, the figure angle range, and the
algebraic nondegeneracy.
nodes.proof_tex:
Eliminate $\|p\|$ between the energy-balance and cosine-law fields of a
lawful configuration at frequency $\omega$: reachability at forward angle
$\theta$ reduces to the official-solution quadratic in $\hbar\omega$
having a real solution, which holds exactly at and above its smallest
positive root.  By the quadratic characterization that root is
$\hbar\,\Omega$, so $\Omega$ is reachable and minimal.
nodes.lean_source:
theorem minimum_angular_frequency_T1_C1
    (reg : ConstantRegime) (θ : ℝ)
    (hrange : IsAngularRange θ) (hfwd : IsForwardBranch θ) (hθpos : 0 < θ)
    (hdisc : 0 ≤ 1 - (dissociationEnergyGap /
        (3 * oxygenAtomMass * speedOfLight ^ 2)) * (2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2 + 1)) :
    IsDissociationThreshold oxygenAtomMass dissociationEnergyGap θ
      (hbarOmegaMin oxygenAtomMass speedOfLight dissociationEnergyGap θ) := by
  sorry

nodes.title: Minimum angular frequency, backward branch
nodes.statement:
In the positive-constant regime, for a backward angle
$\pi/2 \le \theta \le \pi$ with a real square root (at $\theta = \pi/2$),
the dissociation threshold freezes at its $\theta = \pi/2$ value: the
threshold at $\theta$ is the forward-branch candidate evaluated at
$\pi/2$, $\Omega(m, c, \Delta U, \pi/2)$.  The recorded answer again
occurs only in the conclusion.
nodes.proof_tex:
The tangent-line critical configuration of Figure~1c exists only in the
forward branch, so for $\theta \ge \pi/2$ the binding constraint is the
$\pi/2$ one; formally this rests on the forward-branch threshold theorem
at $\pi/2$ together with the reflection symmetry of the candidate formula.
nodes.lean_source:
theorem minimum_angular_frequency_backward_branch_T1_C1
    (reg : ConstantRegime) (θ : ℝ)
    (hrange : IsAngularRange θ) (hbwd : Real.pi / 2 ≤ θ)
    (hdisc : 0 ≤ 1 - dissociationEnergyGap /
        (3 * oxygenAtomMass * speedOfLight ^ 2)) :
    IsDissociationThreshold oxygenAtomMass dissociationEnergyGap θ
      (hbarOmegaMin oxygenAtomMass speedOfLight dissociationEnergyGap (Real.pi / 2)) := by
  sorry

nodes.title: Reflection symmetry of the candidate threshold
nodes.statement:
The candidate threshold is invariant under the reflection
$\theta \mapsto \pi - \theta$:
$\Omega(m, c, \Delta U, \pi - \theta) = \Omega(m, c, \Delta U, \theta)$,
the pure-math symmetry justifying the backward-branch freeze.
nodes.proof_tex:
The candidate expression depends on $\theta$ only through $\sin^2\theta$,
and $\sin(\pi - \theta) = \sin\theta$.
nodes.lean_source:
theorem hbarOmegaMin_pi_sub (m c dU θ : ℝ) :
    hbarOmegaMin m c dU (Real.pi - θ) = hbarOmegaMin m c dU θ := by
  sorry

nodes.title: Physics formalization target
nodes.statement: The assigned autoformalize agent should translate this physics problem into Lean declarations in the covered file, with theorem and lemma proof bodies written as `by sorry`.
nodes.proof_tex: This is an autoformalization task, not a proof task. Produce faithful statements that can later be proved without weakening the source contract.

nodes.title: Photodissociation constants bundle
nodes.statement:
The physical constants of the C.2 scenario: the speed of light both as the
PhysLean typed positive real \texttt{SpeedOfLight} (\texttt{c}) and as its SI
value $\texttt{cSI} = 299792458\ \mathrm{m\,s^{-1}}$ (used to convert amu to
kg), one electron-volt $\texttt{eV} = 1.602176634{\cdot}10^{-19}$ J, and one
unified atomic mass unit $\texttt{amu} = 1.66053906660{\cdot}10^{-27}$ kg,
bundled with positivity certificates $\texttt{cSI}, \texttt{eV},
\texttt{amu} > 0$.  $\hbar$ itself is grounded directly in PhysLean's
\texttt{Constants.\hbar} (J\,s), so it is not a field.  The instance
 is the trusted
certificate bundle filling every field with its exact SI value (all
certificates closed by \texttt{norm\_num}/\texttt{rfl}).
nodes.lean_source:
structure PhotoDissociationConstants where

  c : SpeedOfLight

  cSI : ℝ

  eV : ℝ

  amu : ℝ
  cSI_pos : 0 < cSI
  eV_pos : 0 < eV
  amu_pos : 0 < amu
  cSI_val : cSI = 299792458
  eV_val : eV = 1.602176634e-19
  amu_val : amu = 1.66053906660e-27

noncomputable def trusted : PhotoDissociationConstants where
  c := ⟨299792458, by norm_num⟩
  cSI := 299792458
  eV := 1.602176634e-19
  amu := 1.66053906660e-27
  cSI_pos := by norm_num
  eV_pos := by norm_num
  amu_pos := by norm_num
  cSI_val := rfl
  eV_val := rfl
  amu_val := rfl

noncomputable def trusted : PhotoDissociationConstants where
  c := ⟨299792458, by norm_num⟩
  cSI := 299792458
  eV := 1.602176634e-19
  amu := 1.66053906660e-27
  cSI_pos := by norm_num
  eV_pos := by norm_num
  amu_pos := by norm_num
  cSI_val := rfl
  eV_val := rfl
  amu_val := rfl

nodes.title: Dissociation kinematic state
nodes.statement:
The kinematic state of $\gamma + \mathrm{O_3} \to \mathrm{O_2} + \mathrm{O}$
with the parent $\mathrm{O_3}$ at rest: photon angular frequency $\omega$
(rad\,s\textsuperscript{-1}), outgoing $\mathrm{O_2}$ momentum magnitude
$P_{\mathrm{O_2}} \ge 0$ (kg\,m\,s\textsuperscript{-1}), O-atom momentum
components $p_{Ox}, p_{Oy}$ parallel/perpendicular to the photon
(kg\,m\,s\textsuperscript{-1}), angle $\theta$ between the $\mathrm{O_2}$
momentum and the photon (rad), ground-state energies $U_i$ of $\mathrm{O_3}$
and $U_f$ of $\mathrm{O_2}+\mathrm{O}$ (J), and oxygen-atom mass $m > 0$ (kg)
— so the fragments have masses $2m$ and $m$ and the parent $3m$.  The
projection  is the internal-energy
change $\Delta U := U_f - U_i$ (J), the dissociation threshold energy.
nodes.lean_source:
structure DissociationState where

  ω : ℝ

  P_O2 : ℝ

  pOx : ℝ

  pOy : ℝ

  θ : ℝ

  U_i : ℝ

  U_f : ℝ

  m : ℝ
  m_pos : 0 < m
  P_O2_nonneg : 0 ≤ P_O2

def DissociationState.ΔU (s : DissociationState) : ℝ := s.U_f - s.U_i

def DissociationState.ΔU (s : DissociationState) : ℝ := s.U_f - s.U_i

nodes.title: Ozone-photodissociation reaction predicate
nodes.statement:
The governing physical laws of the model, \emph{assumed} as conservation-law
hypotheses: the Planck--Einstein photon relations $E_\gamma = \hbar\omega$ and
$p_\gamma = \hbar\omega/c \ge 0$; momentum conservation parallel and
perpendicular to the beam,
$\hbar\omega/c = P_{\mathrm{O_2}}\cos\theta + p_{Ox}$ and
$0 = P_{\mathrm{O_2}}\sin\theta + p_{Oy}$; energy conservation with classical
non-relativistic fragment kinetic energies,
$\hbar\omega + U_i = U_f + P_{\mathrm{O_2}}^2/(2\cdot 2m) +
(p_{Ox}^2 + p_{Oy}^2)/(2m)$; and the needed nonnegativity of the
dissociation energy, $\Delta U \ge 0$.  The numeric threshold
($\hbar\omega_{\min}$ values) stays conclusion-side; it is not among these
fields.
nodes.lean_source:
structure IsOzonePhotodissociation (K : PhotoDissociationConstants)
    (s : DissociationState) : Prop where
  photon_energy : Constants.ℏ.val * s.ω = (Constants.ℏ.val * s.ω / (K.c : ℝ)) * (K.c : ℝ)
  photon_momentum : 0 ≤ Constants.ℏ.val * s.ω / (K.c : ℝ)
  momentum_parallel : Constants.ℏ.val * s.ω / (K.c : ℝ) =
    s.P_O2 * Real.cos s.θ + s.pOx
  momentum_perp : 0 = s.P_O2 * Real.sin s.θ + s.pOy
  energy_conservation : Constants.ℏ.val * s.ω + s.U_i =
    s.U_f + s.P_O2 ^ 2 / (2 * (2 * s.m)) + (s.pOx ^ 2 + s.pOy ^ 2) / (2 * s.m)
  deltaU_nonneg_needed : 0 ≤ s.U_f - s.U_i

nodes.title: Positivity of the photon energy
nodes.statement: In any lawful dissociation state, $\omega > 0$ implies $\hbar\omega > 0$.
nodes.proof_tex:
$\hbar > 0$ by PhysLean's \texttt{Constants.\hbar.property}, so the product of
positive reals is positive.
nodes.lean_source:
theorem photon_energy_pos_of_omega_pos {K : PhotoDissociationConstants}
    {s : DissociationState} (h : IsOzonePhotodissociation K s)
    (hω : 0 < s.ω) : 0 < Constants.ℏ.val * s.ω := by
  have hℏ : (0:ℝ) < Constants.ℏ.val := Constants.ℏ.property
  exact mul_pos hℏ hω

nodes.title: Released kinetic energy is nonnegative
nodes.statement:
In any lawful dissociation state the photon energy in excess of the
threshold satisfies $0 \le \hbar\omega - \Delta U$: by energy conservation
this gap is exactly the total non-relativistic fragment kinetic energy
(masses $2m$ and $m$).
nodes.proof_tex:
Both kinetic terms are quotients of sums of squares by positive masses, hence
nonnegative; unfold $\Delta U = U_f - U_i$ in the energy-conservation field
and close by \texttt{linarith}.
nodes.lean_source:
theorem rest_energy_gap_nonneg {K : PhotoDissociationConstants}
    {s : DissociationState} (h : IsOzonePhotodissociation K s) :
    0 ≤ Constants.ℏ.val * s.ω - s.ΔU := by
  have hm : (0:ℝ) < 2 * s.m := by linarith [s.m_pos]
  have hT1 : 0 ≤ s.P_O2 ^ 2 / (2 * (2 * s.m)) := by
    apply div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) ; linarith
  have hT2 : 0 ≤ (s.pOx ^ 2 + s.pOy ^ 2) / (2 * s.m) := by
    apply div_nonneg (add_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _)) ; linarith
  have := h.energy_conservation
  unfold DissociationState.ΔU
  linarith

nodes.title: C.2 calibrated input data
nodes.statement:
The problem-given input readouts of part C.2, recorded over a constants
bundle $K$: the scattering angle $\theta = \pi/6$ (rad), the dissociation
energy in electron-volts $\Delta U_{\mathrm{eV}} = 1.10$ and in joules
$\Delta U_{\mathrm{J}} = \Delta U_{\mathrm{eV}}\cdot K.\texttt{eV}$, the
oxygen-atom mass in atomic units $m_{\mathrm{amu}} = 16.0$ and in kilograms
$m_{\mathrm{kg}} = m_{\mathrm{amu}}\cdot K.\texttt{amu}$, and the derived
dimensionless threshold parameter of the C.1 formula,
$\texttt{ratio} = \Delta U_{\mathrm{J}}/(3 m_{\mathrm{kg}}
K.\texttt{cSI}^2)$.  The equation certificates ($\theta = \pi/6$, the two
unit conversions, the defining quotient for $\texttt{ratio}$) keep every
later use non-degenerate: no numeric conclusion is hidden in the data layer.
nodes.lean_source:
structure C2CalibratedData (K : PhotoDissociationConstants) where

  θ : ℝ

  ΔU_eV : ℝ

  m_amu : ℝ

  ΔU_J : ℝ

  m_kg : ℝ

  ratio : ℝ
  θ_val : θ = Real.pi / 6
  ΔU_eV_val : ΔU_eV = 1.10
  m_amu_val : m_amu = 16.0
  ΔU_J_def : ΔU_J = ΔU_eV * K.eV
  m_kg_def : m_kg = m_amu * K.amu
  ratio_def : ratio = ΔU_J / (3 * m_kg * K.cSI ^ 2)

nodes.title: C.1 threshold photon energy $\hbar\omega_{\min}(\theta)$
nodes.statement:
The minimum photon energy required for dissociation at outgoing O$_2$ angle
$\theta \le \pi/2$, inherited from part C.1 as a natural-language
prerequisite and written (as an energy, keeping $\hbar$ outside the
quotient) as a function of the rest scale $mc^2$ and the gap $\Delta U$:
\[
\hbar\omega_{\min}(\theta) =
\frac{3 m c^2\Bigl(1 - \sqrt{1 - \tfrac{\Delta U}{3 m c^2}
\bigl(2\sin^2\theta + 1\bigr)}\Bigr)}{2\sin^2\theta + 1} .
\]
This is a formula over the physical parameters, not the numeric C.2 answer.
nodes.proof_tex:
[Derivation sketch]
Energy conservation $\hbar\omega = \Delta U + T_{\mathrm{O_2}} + T_{\mathrm{O}}$
with $T_{\mathrm{O_2}} = P^2/(4m)$, $T_{\mathrm{O}} = q^2/(2m)$, and momentum
conservation with the parent at rest, $p_\gamma = \hbar\omega/c = \vec P + \vec q$
at relative angle $\theta$, eliminate the O-atom momentum $q$; minimizing the
resulting one-parameter family $\hbar\omega(P)$ at fixed $\theta, \Delta U$ by
setting its derivative to zero gives the minimum-energy (threshold) condition,
whose solution is the displayed expression (the minimum is approached at
nearly collinear fragment emission).
nodes.lean_source:
noncomputable def hbarOmegaMin (mc2 ΔU θ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  3 * mc2 * (1 - Real.sqrt (1 - 2 * (ΔU / (3 * mc2)) * (2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2 + 1))) /
    (2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2 + 1)

nodes.title: Angular factor at $\theta = \pi/6$
nodes.statement:
The $2\sin^2\theta + 1$ multiplier of the C.1 threshold at the calibrated
angle is $2\sin^2(\pi/6) + 1 = 3/2$.
nodes.proof_tex:
Equivalently $2 - \cos(2\theta) = 2 - \cos(\pi/3) = 2 - \tfrac12 = \tfrac32$
(the $\cos(\pi/6) = \sqrt{3}/2$ datum of the momentum-direction geometry):
substitute $\sin(\pi/6) = 1/2$ and simplify the pure rational arithmetic.
nodes.lean_source:
theorem angular_factor_at_pi_div_six :
    2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / 6) ^ 2 + 1 = 3 / 2 := by
  have hs : Real.sin (Real.pi / 6) = 1 / 2 := Real.sin_pi_div_six
  rw [hs]
  norm_num

nodes.title: Threshold at $\theta = \pi/6$ in calibrated form
nodes.statement:
The C.1 threshold specialized to $\theta = \pi/6$, as a function of the rest
scale $mc^2$ and of the dimensionless ratio $r = \Delta U/(3 m c^2)$:
$\hbar\omega_{\min}(\pi/6) = \tfrac{1}{3/2}\cdot 3 m c^2
\bigl(1 - \sqrt{1 - \tfrac{3 r}{2}}\bigr)$, written with the
$1/(3/2)$--$(3 m c^2)$ normalization kept explicit so the collapse
$3/(3/2) = 2$ to the compact form $2 m c^2(1 - \sqrt{1 - 3r/2})$ is visible.
nodes.lean_source:
noncomputable def hbarOmegaMinAtPiDivSix (mc2 r : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1:ℝ) / (3 / 2) * (3 * mc2) * (1 - Real.sqrt (1 - 2 * r * (3 / 2)))

nodes.title: Bridge: C.1 threshold evaluated at $\pi/6$
nodes.statement:
For $3 m c^2 \ne 0$, evaluating the C.1 threshold at $\theta = \pi/6$ yields
exactly the calibrated form:
$\hbar\omega_{\min}(\pi/6) = \texttt{hbarOmegaMinAtPiDivSix}\,mc^2\,
(\Delta U/(3 m c^2))$.
nodes.proof_tex:
Substitute the angular factor $2\sin^2(\pi/6) + 1 = 3/2$ into the defining
quotient of $\hbar\omega_{\min}$; both sides then share the radicand
$1 - (\Delta U/(3mc^2))\cdot 3/2 = 1 - 3r/2$ (well-defined by the
non-degeneracy of the denominator), and the two expressions agree by the
field identities $x/(3/2) = (1/(3/2))\,x$ and
$(1/(3/2))\,x\bigl(1-\sqrt{1-3r/2}\bigr)
= (1/(3/2))(3mc^2)\bigl(1-\sqrt{1-(\Delta U/(3mc^2))(3/2)}\bigr)$ for
$x = 3mc^2 \ne 0$.
nodes.lean_source:
theorem hbarOmegaMin_at_pi_div_six (mc2 ΔU : ℝ) (hmc2 : 3 * mc2 ≠ 0) :
    hbarOmegaMin mc2 ΔU (Real.pi / 6) = hbarOmegaMinAtPiDivSix mc2 (ΔU / (3 * mc2)) := by
  have hf : (2:ℝ) * Real.sin (Real.pi / 6) ^ 2 + 1 = 3 / 2 := angular_factor_at_pi_div_six
  unfold hbarOmegaMin hbarOmegaMinAtPiDivSix
  rw [hf]
  ring

nodes.title: Physical realizability of the threshold
nodes.statement:
A photon energy $E$ is physically realizable at the C.2 calibration data
when there exists a lawful dissociation state $s$ (satisfying
\texttt{IsOzonePhotodissociation}), at the calibrated angle $\theta = \pi/6$,
mass $m = m_{\mathrm{kg}}$ and gap $\Delta U = \Delta U_{\mathrm{J}}$, whose
photon energy equals $E$: $\hbar\omega_s = E$.  At the threshold value this
asserts existence of the minimizing state in which energy and momentum
conservation hold with equality --- the minimum-energy condition itself.
nodes.lean_source:
def ThresholdRealizable (K : PhotoDissociationConstants)
    (d : C2CalibratedData K) (E : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ s : DissociationState, IsOzonePhotodissociation K s ∧
    s.θ = d.θ ∧ s.m = d.m_kg ∧ s.ΔU = d.ΔU_J ∧ Constants.ℏ.val * s.ω = E ∧
    ThresholdBalance (2 * Real.sin s.θ ^ 2 + 1) (d.m_kg * K.cSI ^ 2) s.ΔU E ∧
    LowerRootBranch (2 * Real.sin s.θ ^ 2 + 1) (d.m_kg * K.cSI ^ 2) E

nodes.title: C.2 target: excess photon energy at threshold
nodes.statement:
Assume the trusted constants, the C.2 calibration data, the smallness and
positivity of the threshold parameter ($0 < \texttt{ratio} < 2/3$, so the
square root is real), and physical realizability of the C.1 threshold.  Then
the minimum photon energy in excess of the dissociation gap, in eV, is the
tiny positive value recorded in the problem, certified by the rigorous
two-sided enclosure
$0 < \bigl(\hbar\omega_{\min}(\pi/6) - \Delta U\bigr)/\mathrm{eV}$ and
$\bigl|\bigl(\hbar\omega_{\min}(\pi/6) - \Delta U\bigr)/\mathrm{eV}
- 2.03{\cdot}10^{-11}\bigr| < 5{\cdot}10^{-14}$ --- the strict
``remaining kinetic energy vanishes at minimum photon energy'' marker that
identifies the recorded official threshold ($\hbar\omega_{\min} - \Delta U
\approx 2.03{\cdot}10^{-11}$ eV appears only here, conclusion-side).
nodes.proof_tex:
Rewrite the threshold at $\theta = \pi/6$ through the bridge to the
calibrated $\pi/6$ form and linearize $1 - \sqrt{1 - \varepsilon}
= \varepsilon/2 + \varepsilon^2/8 + O(\varepsilon^3)$ at
$\varepsilon = 3\,\texttt{ratio}/2 \approx 3.7{\cdot}10^{-11}$: the linear
term reproduces exactly $\Delta U$, so the surviving
$\varepsilon^2/8$ contribution is the whole gap,
$\Delta U\, \cdot 3\,\texttt{ratio}/8 \approx 2.03{\cdot}10^{-11}$ eV,
certified by rational two-sided squaring bounds on the square root at the
trusted SI readouts; positivity of the gap already follows from energy
conservation (the released kinetic energy is nonnegative).
nodes.lean_source:
theorem excess_photon_energy_at_threshold
    (K : PhotoDissociationConstants) (hK : K = PhotoDissociationConstants.trusted)
    (d : C2CalibratedData K)
    (h_real : ThresholdRealizable K d
      (hbarOmegaMin (d.m_kg * K.cSI ^ 2) d.ΔU_J d.θ)) :
    let gap_eV := (hbarOmegaMin (d.m_kg * K.cSI ^ 2) d.ΔU_J d.θ - d.ΔU_J) / K.eV
    0 < gap_eV ∧ |gap_eV - 2.03e-11| < 5e-14 := by
  have hKc : K.cSI = 299792458 := by rw [hK]; rfl
  have hKe : K.eV = 1.602176634e-19 := by rw [hK]; rfl
  have hKa : K.amu = 1.66053906660e-27 := by rw [hK]; rfl
  obtain ⟨s, hs, sθ, sm, sΔU, sE, hbal, hlow⟩ := h_real
  set E : ℝ := hbarOmegaMin (d.m_kg * K.cSI ^ 2) d.ΔU_J d.θ with hE_def
  set mc2J : ℝ := d.m_kg * K.cSI ^ 2 with hmc2_def
  set S : ℝ := 2 * Real.sin s.θ ^ 2 + 1 with hS_def
  have hm_pos : (0:ℝ) < d.m_kg := by
    rw [d.m_kg_def]
    apply mul_pos (by rw [d.m_amu_val]; norm_num) K.amu_pos
  have hc_pos : (0:ℝ) < K.cSI := K.cSI_pos
  have hmc2_pos : (0:ℝ) < mc2J := mul_pos hm_pos (sq_pos_of_pos hc_pos)
  have hΔJ_pos : (0:ℝ) < d.ΔU_J := by
    rw [d.ΔU_J_def]
    apply mul_pos (by rw [d.ΔU_eV_val]; norm_num) K.eV_pos
  have hS_val : S = 3 / 2 := by
    rw [hS_def, sθ, d.θ_val]
    exact angular_factor_at_pi_div_six
  have hS_pos : (0:ℝ) < S := by rw [hS_val]; norm_num
  have hE_nn : (0:ℝ) ≤ E := by
    have hg := hs.rest_energy_gap_nonneg
    rw [sE, sΔU] at hg
    linarith [hg]
  have hbranch : 2 * d.ΔU_J * S ≤ mc2J := by
    rw [hS_val, hmc2_def, d.ΔU_J_def, d.m_kg_def, hKc, hKe, hKa, d.ΔU_eV_val, d.m_amu_val]
    norm_num
  have hbMF : S * (E / K.eV) ^ 2 / (6 * (mc2J / K.eV)) - E / K.eV + d.ΔU_J / K.eV = 0 :=
    thresholdBalance_to_ev_units S d.ΔU_J mc2J K.eV E hmc2_pos K.eV_pos
      (show ThresholdBalance S mc2J d.ΔU_J E from by rw [← sΔU]; exact hbal)
  have hlowF : E / K.eV ≤ 3 * (mc2J / K.eV) / S := by
    rw [show 3 * (mc2J / K.eV) / S = (3 * mc2J / S) / K.eV by
      field_simp]
    exact (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right K.eV_pos).mpr hlow
  have hFnn : (0:ℝ) ≤ E / K.eV := div_nonneg hE_nn K.eV_pos.le
  have hΔF_pos : (0:ℝ) < d.ΔU_J / K.eV := div_pos hΔJ_pos K.eV_pos
  have hMF_pos : (0:ℝ) < mc2J / K.eV := div_pos hmc2_pos K.eV_pos
  have hbranchF : 2 * (d.ΔU_J / K.eV) * S ≤ mc2J / K.eV := by
    rw [show 2 * (d.ΔU_J / K.eV) * S = (2 * d.ΔU_J * S) / K.eV by
      field_simp]
    exact (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right K.eV_pos).mpr hbranch
  obtain ⟨hL, hU⟩ := threshold_excess_enclosure S (mc2J / K.eV) (d.ΔU_J / K.eV)
    (E / K.eV) hbMF hlowF hFnn hΔF_pos hMF_pos hS_pos hbranchF
  have hS3 : S = 3 / 2 := hS_val
  rw [hS3] at hL hU
  have hΔval : d.ΔU_J / K.eV = 11 / 10 := by
    rw [d.ΔU_J_def, hKe, d.ΔU_eV_val]
    field_simp
    norm_num
  have hMval : mc2J / K.eV =
      16 * 8302695333 * 299792458 ^ 2 / (801088317 * 10 ^ 9 : ℝ) := by
    rw [hmc2_def, d.m_kg_def, hKc, hKe, hKa, d.m_amu_val]
    norm_num
  rw [hΔval, hMval] at hL hU
  have hbL : (2.025e-11 : ℝ) < (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (11 / 10) ^ 2 /
      (6 * (16 * 8302695333 * 299792458 ^ 2 / (801088317 * 10 ^ 9))) := by
    norm_num
  have hbU : (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (11 / 10) ^ 2 /
        (6 * (16 * 8302695333 * 299792458 ^ 2 / (801088317 * 10 ^ 9))) *
        (1 + 3 * ((3 / 2 : ℝ) / (6 * (16 * 8302695333 * 299792458 ^ 2 / (801088317 * 10 ^ 9))))
          * (2 * (11 / 10))) < (2.034e-11 : ℝ) := by
    norm_num
  have h1 : (2.025e-11 : ℝ) < E / K.eV - d.ΔU_J / K.eV := by
    nlinarith [hbL, hL]
  have h2 : E / K.eV - d.ΔU_J / K.eV < (2.034e-11 : ℝ) := by
    nlinarith [hbU, hU]
  have hconv : (E - d.ΔU_J) / K.eV = E / K.eV - d.ΔU_J / K.eV := by
    field_simp
  constructor
  · rw [hconv]
    linarith [h1]
  · rw [hconv, abs_lt]
    constructor <;> linarith [h1, h2]

nodes.title: C.2 target: specialized $\pi/6$ form of the excess
nodes.statement:
Helper form of the main target with the calibrated
$\theta = \pi/6$ threshold in place: with
$r = \Delta U/(3 m c^2)$, the excess in eV
$\bigl(\tfrac{3mc^2}{3/2}\bigl(1-\sqrt{1-\tfrac{3r}{2}}\bigr)
- \Delta U\bigr)/\mathrm{eV}$ is positive and within
$5{\cdot}10^{-14}$ of the recorded value $2.03{\cdot}10^{-11}$ eV.
nodes.proof_tex:
Rewrite $\hbar\omega_{\min}(\pi/6)$ by the bridge theorem
\ref{thm:IPhO2026Problems_problem_IPhO_2026_1_C_2:hbarOmegaMin_at_pi_div_six}
(the mass-energy scale $3mc^2$ at $m = 16.0$ amu is nonzero), then apply the
same $1 - \sqrt{1-\varepsilon}$ linearization and the two-sided rational
enclosure at the trusted constants as in
\ref{thm:IPhO2026Problems_problem_IPhO_2026_1_C_2:excess_photon_energy_at_threshold}.
nodes.lean_source:
theorem excess_photon_energy_pi_div_six_form
    (K : PhotoDissociationConstants) (hK : K = PhotoDissociationConstants.trusted)
    (d : C2CalibratedData K)
    (h_real : ThresholdRealizable K d
      (hbarOmegaMin (d.m_kg * K.cSI ^ 2) d.ΔU_J d.θ)) :
    let gap_eV := (hbarOmegaMinAtPiDivSix (d.m_kg * K.cSI ^ 2) d.ratio - d.ΔU_J) / K.eV
    0 < gap_eV ∧ |gap_eV - 2.03e-11| < 5e-14 := by
  have hmc2_ne : 3 * (d.m_kg * K.cSI ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by
    have hm : (0:ℝ) < d.m_kg := by
      rw [d.m_kg_def]
      apply mul_pos (by rw [d.m_amu_val]; norm_num) K.amu_pos
    exact ne_of_gt (mul_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 3) (mul_pos hm (sq_pos_of_pos K.cSI_pos)))
  have hbridge := hbarOmegaMin_at_pi_div_six (d.m_kg * K.cSI ^ 2) d.ΔU_J hmc2_ne
  have hmain := excess_photon_energy_at_threshold K hK d h_real
  have hconv : hbarOmegaMinAtPiDivSix (d.m_kg * K.cSI ^ 2) (d.ΔU_J / (3 * (d.m_kg * K.cSI ^ 2)))
      = hbarOmegaMin (d.m_kg * K.cSI ^ 2) d.ΔU_J (Real.pi / 6) := hbridge.symm
  have hθ : d.θ = Real.pi / 6 := d.θ_val
  rw [hθ] at hmain
  have hrd : d.ratio = d.ΔU_J / (3 * (d.m_kg * K.cSI ^ 2)) := by
    have e1 := d.ratio_def
    have e2 : (3 : ℝ) * d.m_kg * K.cSI ^ 2 = 3 * (d.m_kg * K.cSI ^ 2) := by ring
    rw [e2] at e1
    exact e1
  rw [hrd, hconv]
  exact hmain

nodes.title: Squared momentum balance
nodes.statement:
Eliminating the O-atom angle between the two momentum-conservation equations
gives the ellipse-like constraint used downstream by the C.1 minimization:
with $p_\gamma = \hbar\omega/c$,
$(p_\gamma - P_{\mathrm{O_2}}\cos\theta)^2 + (P_{\mathrm{O_2}}\sin\theta)^2
= p_{Ox}^2 + p_{Oy}^2$.
nodes.proof_tex:
Solve the parallel/perpendicular momentum fields for $p_{Ox}$ and $p_{Oy}$,
substitute, and close by \texttt{ring}.
nodes.lean_source:
theorem momentum_balance_sq {K : PhotoDissociationConstants}
    {s : DissociationState} (h : IsOzonePhotodissociation K s) :
    (Constants.ℏ.val * s.ω / (K.c : ℝ) - s.P_O2 * Real.cos s.θ) ^ 2
      + (s.P_O2 * Real.sin s.θ) ^ 2
    = s.pOx ^ 2 + s.pOy ^ 2 := by
  have hx : s.pOx = Constants.ℏ.val * s.ω / (K.c : ℝ) - s.P_O2 * Real.cos s.θ := by
    linarith [h.momentum_parallel]
  have hy : s.pOy = - s.P_O2 * Real.sin s.θ := by
    linarith [h.momentum_perp]
  rw [hx, hy]
  ring

nodes.title: Threshold balance (momentum-energy root form)
nodes.statement:
The scalar threshold condition `S·E²/(6·mc²) − E + ΔU = 0`: the photon
energy splits into the dissociation gap plus the recoil kinetic energy of
the fragments, with the quadratic coefficient fixed by momentum
conservation at the minimizing configuration (`mc2` the atomic rest scale
`m·c²`, since the O₂ and O recoil masses are `2m` and `m`).  With
`S(θ) = 2 sin²θ + 1` this is exactly the C.1 threshold lower root
rationalized (`S·E²/(6·mc2) − E + ΔU = 0` ⇔ `E = (3mc²/S)(1 − √(1 − S·ΔU/(3mc²)))`),
but unlike the √-form it is well conditioned for exact rational enclosure
proofs at the tiny C.2 ratio.
nodes.proof_tex: Definition; no claim.
nodes.lean_source:
def ThresholdBalance (S mc2 ΔU E : ℝ) : Prop :=
  S * E ^ 2 / (6 * mc2) - E + ΔU = 0

nodes.title: Lower-root (physical) branch of the threshold
nodes.statement:
The physical (minimum-energy / lower-root) branch of the threshold
quadratic: the threshold energy lies below the root-crossing,
`E ≤ 3·mc²/S`.  Both roots of
\cref{def:IPhO2026Problems_problem_IPhO_2026_1_C_2:ThresholdBalance} are
positive when real; the smaller one is the minimum photon energy.
nodes.proof_tex: Definition; no claim.
nodes.lean_source:
def LowerRootBranch (S mc2 E : ℝ) : Prop :=
  E ≤ 3 * mc2 / S

nodes.title: Threshold-excess enclosure at generic scales
nodes.statement:
Let `F` be a nonnegative solution of the threshold balance on the
lower-root branch, with `0 < ΔU`, `0 < mc²`, `0 < S` and the smallness
certificate `2·ΔU·S ≤ mc²`.  Then the threshold excess over the gap is
enclosed between the leading recoil coefficient `b = S·ΔU²/(6·mc²)` and
its one-step bootstrap `b·(1 + 3·(S/(6·mc²))·(2ΔU))`:
`b < F − ΔU ≤ b·(1 + 3·(S/(6·mc²))·(2ΔU))`.
nodes.proof_tex:
With `c := 3·mc²/S` the balance rewrites as `c·(F−ΔU) = F²/2`, i.e.
`(F−ΔU)·(2c−F) = F·ΔU`; the branch condition and the smallness certificate
give `F ≤ 2ΔU < c`, and bootstrapping the quotient
`F−ΔU = F·ΔU/(2c−F)` once against `F ≤ 2ΔU` and then against the
resulting bound yields `F−ΔU ≤ ΔU²/(2c−3ΔU) ≤ b·(1 + 3·B·(2ΔU))` with
`B := S/(6·mc²)`; the lower bound `F−ΔU = B·F² > B·ΔU² = b` is immediate
from `ΔU < F`.
nodes.lean_source:
theorem threshold_excess_enclosure
    (S mc2 ΔU F : ℝ)
    (h : ThresholdBalance S mc2 ΔU F)
    (hlow : LowerRootBranch S mc2 F)
    (hF0 : 0 ≤ F) (hΔ : 0 < ΔU) (hmc : 0 < mc2) (hS : 0 < S)
    (hmcBig : 2 * ΔU * S ≤ mc2) :
    S * ΔU ^ 2 / (6 * mc2) < F - ΔU ∧
    F - ΔU ≤ S * ΔU ^ 2 / (6 * mc2) * (1 + 3 * (S / (6 * mc2)) * (2 * ΔU)) := by
  have hS6 : (0:ℝ) < 6 * mc2 := by positivity
  set c : ℝ := 3 * mc2 / S with hc
  have hB : (0:ℝ) < S / (6 * mc2) := by positivity
  have hcb : c * (S / (6 * mc2)) = 1 / 2 := by
    rw [hc]; field_simp; ring
  have hcpos : (0:ℝ) < c := by rw [hc]; positivity
  have hbal : F - ΔU = S / (6 * mc2) * F ^ 2 := by
    have := h
    unfold ThresholdBalance at this
    field_simp at this ⊢
    nlinarith [this]
  have hΔF : ΔU ≤ F := by
    have nn := mul_nonneg hB.le (sq_nonneg F)
    linarith [hbal]
  have hFp : (0:ℝ) < F := hΔ.trans_le hΔF
  have hgt : (0:ℝ) < F - ΔU := by
    have p := mul_pos hB (sq_pos_of_pos hFp)
    linarith [hbal]
  have hbEq : S * ΔU ^ 2 / (6 * mc2) = (S / (6 * mc2)) * ΔU ^ 2 := by ring
  have hLower : S * ΔU ^ 2 / (6 * mc2) < F - ΔU := by
    rw [hbEq, hbal]
    apply mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left _ hB
    nlinarith [hΔF, hgt, hFp]
  have hBF : S / (6 * mc2) * F ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    have le : S / (6 * mc2) * F ≤ S / (6 * mc2) * c :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlow hB.le
    have eq : S / (6 * mc2) * c = 1 / 2 := by rw [hc]; field_simp; ring
    linarith [le, eq]
  have hF2 : F ≤ 2 * ΔU := by
    have hb : F * (1 - S / (6 * mc2) * F) = ΔU := by linear_combination hbal
    have h1BF : 1 / 2 ≤ 1 - S / (6 * mc2) * F := by linarith [hBF]
    nlinarith [hb, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1BF hF0]
  have hc3 : 6 * ΔU ≤ c := by
    rw [hc, le_div_iff₀ hS]
    nlinarith [hmcBig, hS]
  have hcF : F < c := by
    have h2 : 2 * ΔU < c := by linarith [hc3, hΔ]
    linarith [hF2]
  have e1 : c * (F - ΔU) = F ^ 2 / 2 := by
    have e : c * (F - ΔU) = (c * (S / (6 * mc2))) * F ^ 2 := by rw [hbal]; ring
    rw [e, hcb]; ring
  have keyid2 : (F - ΔU) * (2 * c - F) = F * ΔU := by
    linear_combination 2 * e1
  have hcd2 : (0:ℝ) < 2 * c - F := by linarith [hcF, hcpos]
  have hc1 : F - ΔU = F * ΔU / (2 * c - F) := by
    rw [eq_div_iff hcd2.ne']
    linear_combination keyid2
  have hden2 : (0:ℝ) < 2 * c - 3 * ΔU := by linarith [hc3, hΔ]
  have hpass2 : F - ΔU ≤ ΔU ^ 2 / (2 * c - 3 * ΔU) := by
    rw [hc1, div_le_div_iff₀ hcd2 hden2]
    have p : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * ΔU * (F - ΔU) * (c - F) := by
      have q1 : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * ΔU := by linarith [hΔ]
      exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg q1 hgt.le) (by linarith [hcF])
    have e : F * ΔU * (2 * c - 3 * ΔU) - ΔU ^ 2 * (2 * c - F)
        = -2 * ΔU * (F - ΔU) * (c - F) := by
      linear_combination 4 * ΔU * e1
    linarith [e, p]
  have hpass3 : ΔU ^ 2 / (2 * c - 3 * ΔU) ≤
      S * ΔU ^ 2 / (6 * mc2) * (1 + 3 * (S / (6 * mc2)) * (2 * ΔU)) := by
    have hBval : S / (6 * mc2) = 1 / (2 * c) := by
      rw [eq_div_iff (show (2:ℝ) * c ≠ 0 by positivity)]
      linear_combination 2 * hcb
    have hbEq2 : S * ΔU ^ 2 / (6 * mc2) = ΔU ^ 2 / (2 * c) := by
      calc S * ΔU ^ 2 / (6 * mc2) = (S / (6 * mc2)) * ΔU ^ 2 := by ring
        _ = (1 / (2 * c)) * ΔU ^ 2 := by rw [hBval]
        _ = ΔU ^ 2 / (2 * c) := by ring
    rw [hbEq2, hBval, div_le_iff₀ hden2]
    field_simp
    have hnonneg : (0:ℝ) ≤ 3 * ΔU * (ΔU ^ 2 / c) := by positivity
    nlinarith [hΔ, hc3, hcpos, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hc3 hΔ.le,
      mul_pos hΔ (show (0:ℝ) < 3 * ΔU / (2 * c) by positivity)]
  exact ⟨hLower, hpass2.trans hpass3⟩

nodes.title: Atomic rest-energy readout in eV
nodes.statement:
The rest-energy scale `mc²` of one oxygen atom at the trusted SI readouts,
expressed in eV as an exact rational:
`mc² = 16·amu·cSI²/eV`
with `amu = 8302695333/5·10³⁶ kg` and `eV = 801088317/5·10²⁷ J`, i.e.
the rational `16·8302695333·299792458²/(801088317·10⁹)`.
nodes.proof_tex: Definition; no claim.

nodes.title: Atomic rest-energy readout is positive
nodes.statement: `0 < mc2eV_trusted`.
nodes.proof_tex: All factors of the defining rational are positive.
nodes.lean_source:
theorem mc2eV_trusted_pos : (0:ℝ) < mc2eV_trusted := by
  unfold mc2eV_trusted; positivity

nodes.title: Atomic rest-energy readout lower bound
nodes.statement:
`2·(11/10)·(3/2) ≤ mc2eV_trusted` — the atomic rest scale dwarfs the
1.10 eV gap with margin, the analytic input to the smallness certificate
`2·ΔU·S ≤ mc²`.
nodes.proof_tex: Exact rational arithmetic on the defining numeral.
nodes.lean_source:
theorem mc2eV_trusted_big : 2 * (11 / 10 : ℝ) * (3 / 2) ≤ mc2eV_trusted := by
  unfold mc2eV_trusted; norm_num

nodes.title: Normal form of the atomic rest-energy readout
nodes.statement:
`mc2eV_trusted = 16·8302695333·299792458²/(801088317·10⁹)` — the definitional
unfolding, kept as a named rewriting handle for downstream arithmetic.
nodes.proof_tex: Definitional equality (reflexivity).

nodes.title: Threshold balance survives eV unit conversion
nodes.statement:
Dividing all energies by the joule value of one eV preserves the threshold
balance: from `ThresholdBalance S mc2_J ΔU_J E_J` at positive `mc2_J` and
eV, `S·(E_J/eV)²/(6·(mc2_J/eV)) − E_J/eV + ΔU_J/eV = 0`.
nodes.proof_tex:
The converted left-hand side equals the original balance divided by eV;
substituting the hypothesis closes the identity by field arithmetic.
nodes.lean_source:
theorem thresholdBalance_to_ev_units
    (S ΔU_J mc2_J eV E_J : ℝ)
    (hmc : 0 < mc2_J) (he : (0:ℝ) < eV)
    (hh : ThresholdBalance S mc2_J ΔU_J E_J) :
